changesets.summary: Add additive rust-kit Solana Kit client generation
changesets.details:
Opt-in `--client rust-kit` / `[clients.rust_kit]` generates off-chain Rust clients via `codama-renderers-rust-solana-kit@0.2.1` under `src/generated/`, scaffolding `solana_kit_core` 0.2.1 from crates.io. Defaults stay rust + typescript; rust and cli-rust are unchanged; no cli-rust-kit.

Adding `ClientLanguage::RustKit` is a public enum extension (exhaustiveness), so this is a major bump for `pina_cli` even though the CLI surface is additive.

##### User impact

You can add `rust-kit` to `clients.languages` or pass `--client rust-kit` to generate a Solana Kit Rust client beside the existing PinaPod `rust` client. `pina init` defaults are unchanged. Fresh scaffolds pin `solana_kit_core = "0.2.1"` from crates.io and put generated modules under `src/generated/`. The scaffold writes `Cargo.toml` and `src/lib.rs` only when each is missing, so regenerating in the default modes keeps a crate root you have edited; `--mode overwrite` still replaces every tracked file, including a scaffolded `src/lib.rs`. Generation stages under the resolved temporary directory, so it also works where `TMPDIR` passes through a symbolic link, as it does by default on macOS.

The agent skill's CLI and project-setup references document rust-kit as opt-in Solana Kit Rust client generation.

changesets.summary: symmetric aliasing, const PDAs, and readonly lint
changesets.details:
- Enforce symmetric mutable account aliasing checks (`PinaProgramError::DuplicateMutableAccount`) across all mutable account slots, allow `readonly + mut` combinations under Pinocchio runtime borrow guards, support opt-in `#[pina(unique)]` to forbid aliasing against any other present account slot (readonly, mutable, or remaining), and preserve Anchor v2 sentinel immunity for omitted optional accounts (`address == program_id`).
- Add inline pairwise aliasing fast paths (2/3/4-mut) and compact zero-`.rodata` bitmask validation in `#[derive(Accounts)]`, eliminating unnecessary runtime overhead and binary bloat.
- Add `#[pina(unique)]` to `Multisig::vault_transaction_execute` in `examples/multisig_program` to reject proposal-account reuse.
- Add compile-time PDA derivation (`try_find_program_address_const`, `find_program_address_const`, and generated `try_find_pda_const` / `find_pda_const` for constant-seed PDAs) and optimize SBF PDA verification via direct `MaybeUninit` syscalls (`-74%` CU on legacy ATA verification, `-64.5%` total CU on `staking_rewards_program`, `-41.6%` on `vesting_program`).
- Add `invoke_signed_with_rent*` builders, opt-in `const-rent` helpers (`default_rent`, `minimum_balance_const`), zero-double-zeroing creation via `pinapod`'s `initialize_zeroed`, and single-pass directional `UpdateResizableAccount` realloc with post-grow divergence guards (`-28.8%` to `-68.4%` CU and `-1,304 B` on `account_realloc_program`, `-1,896 B` on `compact_accounts_program`).
- Track writable vs readonly loader duplicates with 2-bit flags in `entry::walk_accounts`, factor cold failure logging and branch hints in account validators, and shrink ELF sizes across 23 of 28 example programs (up to `-6,496 B` on `multisig_program`) with zero instruction-CU or size regressions.
- Add the `Deny`-level `deny_readonly_account_copy_escalation` compile-time security lint in `pina_lints` and register it in `pina_cli` and the lint reference docs to block mutable borrow escalation on `AccountView` values copied from shared references.

_Owner:_ [@ifiokjr](https://github.com/ifiokjr) · _Review:_ [PR #719](https://github.com/pina-rs/pina/pull/719) · _Related issues:_ [#722](https://github.com/pina-rs/pina/issues/722)
